bifrost: springboard/src/shell/store/api.rs (PC App Store listing; no in-app purchase API found)
summary: Xcode-driven test harness for Apple In-App Purchase, subscriptions and SKAdNetwork ad postbacks. It only works against Apple's App Store and StoreKit, so BifrOSt has no counterpart. BifrOSt's own store has no purchase flow to test.

Apple ad attribution; no BifrOSt equivalent
Apple StoreKit calls; BifrOSt store has no purchase or subscription calls
